an10.87:3.2: When a mendicant is not eager to train, and doesn’t praise taking up the training, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:4.2: When a mendicant has corrupt wishes, and doesn’t praise getting rid of wishes, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:5.2: When a mendicant is irritable, and doesn’t praise getting rid of anger, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:6.2: When a mendicant denigrates others, and doesn’t praise getting rid of denigration, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:7.2: When a mendicant is devious, and doesn’t praise getting rid of deviousness, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:8.2: When a mendicant is deceitful, and doesn’t praise getting rid of deceitfulness, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:9.2: When a mendicant doesn’t pay attention to the teachings, and doesn’t praise attending to the teachings, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:10.2: When a mendicant is not in retreat, and doesn’t praise retreat, this quality too doesn’t conduce to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:15.2: When a mendicant is eager to train, and praises taking up the training, this quality too conduces to fondness, respect, esteem, harmony, and unity.
an10.87:16.2: When a mendicant has few desires, and praises getting rid of desires, this quality … conduces to unity.
an10.87:17.2: When a mendicant is not irritable, and praises getting rid of anger, this quality … conduces to unity.
an10.87:18.2: When a mendicant doesn’t denigrate others, and praises getting rid of denigration, this quality … conduces to unity.
an10.87:19.2: When a mendicant isn’t devious, and praises getting rid of deviousness, this quality … conduces to unity.
an10.87:20.2: When a mendicant isn’t deceitful, and praises getting rid of deceitfulness, this quality … conduces to unity.
an10.87:21.2: When a mendicant pays attention to the teachings, and praises attending to the teachings, this quality … conduces to unity.
an10.87:22.2: When a mendicant is in retreat, and praises retreat, this quality … conduces to unity.
